name: Cindle
title: Flame-Tail Lizard
description: Its violet tail flame burns brighter the longer the session runs.
catchphrase: Keeping the developer cabin warm with steady glowing embers.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Pure glowing hardwood charcoal! Little flame dancing with joy! 🪵🔥
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Crackling cheerfully, throwing warm red embers into the hearth! 🔥
companionPersonality.petReaction: Radiates comforting campfire warmth to keep your tea piping hot! 🔥💖

dialogue.idle: Resting cozy in the cast iron stove, embers pulsing red. 🔥
dialogue.working: Keeping the developer cabin warm through cold outage nights! 🔥⚡
dialogue.thinking: Puffing little smoke rings while tending the inner coals... 🤔
dialogue.success: WARM ROAR! Cozy fire crackles as the successful build lands! 🔥🎉
dialogue.error: A splash of water! Hissing steam and rebuilding the ember core! 💨
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... slumbering as a soft, comforting bed of red coals... 🌙
